t: 据称，亚美利哥·韦斯普奇 (Amerigo Vespucci) 离开加的斯，开始了他第一次前往…
te: Amerigo Vespucci allegedly leaves Cádiz for his first voyage to the New World.
dz: 据称，亚美利哥·韦斯普奇 (Amerigo Vespucci) 离开加的斯，开始了他第一次前往新大陆的航行。
de: Amerigo Vespucci allegedly leaves Cádiz for his first voyage to the New World.

t: 蒙古可汗帖木儿登基为元朝皇帝。
te: Temür, Khagan of the Mongols, is enthroned as Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.
dz: 蒙古可汗帖木儿登基为元朝皇帝。
de: Temür, Khagan of the Mongols, is enthroned as Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

t: 苏格兰贵族在选举国王之前承认英格兰爱德华一世的权威。
te: Scottish nobles recognize the authority of Edward I of England pending the selection of a king.
dz: 苏格兰贵族在选举国王之前承认英格兰爱德华一世的权威。
de: Scottish nobles recognize the authority of Edward I of England pending the selection of a king.

t: 斯波莱托的阿尔贝里克二世在教宗马里努斯二世去世后安排了阿加佩图斯二世的教皇选举.
te: Alberic II of Spoleto arranges the election of pope Agapetus II following the death of Pope Marinus II.
dz: 斯波莱托的阿尔贝里克二世在教宗马里努斯二世去世后安排了阿加佩图斯二世的教皇选举.
de: Alberic II of Spoleto arranges the election of pope Agapetus II following the death of Pope Marinus II.

dz: 汉朝天文学家在汉献帝成帝统治时期所观测到的太阳点,是中国最早的日出观测之一.
de: A sunspot is observed by Han dynasty astronomers during the reign of Emperor Cheng of Han, one of the earliest dated sunspot observations in China.
